The city is brimming with optimism and hope. The dirty streets of the outer boroughs are just a stepping stone toward harmony and the promise of the new world. With ingenuity, hard work, and freedom from oppression, look at what has been accomplished in such a short time. Goods flow into and out of the boroughs every day, but the city is the center of it all. It has attracted all the top talent, savvy business folk, and is quickly becoming a refuge for the rich and powerful. Elvish influences have shaped the architecture, and the city boasts new wonders every day.
